comment: 28 distinct Seedance 2.0 clips (no-repeat). 6x10s + 22x5s = ~765 credits. Assembled with slow-mo + crossfade to ~300s. BRAND-SAFE: generic glowing property board, NO Monopoly logo/name/Mr.Monopoly, NO on-screen text/letters. Pixar 3D, soccer-only, cinematic.
style_suffix: Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic volumetric lighting, warm rounded shapes, shallow depth of field, 16:9, highly detailed, soccer/football only (round-neck shirts, NO helmet, NO american football). ABSOLUTELY NO text, NO letters, NO words, NO numbers, NO logos anywhere in frame.

clips.prompt: A single golden coin spins in slow motion on pure black, catching the light, then lands flat; the camera pulls back to reveal a cathedral-sized dark hall holding a colossal glowing property-trading board game shaped like a road to a golden World Cup trophy, squares lighting up one by one like miniature football stadiums at night.

A faceless figure in a glowing golden hooded cloak floats above a giant illuminated board game and slowly raises one hand; four ornate empty thrones at the four corners ignite with light, embers drifting, mysterious and regal, slow majestic camera push-in.
Four glowing game tokens shaped like tiny golden footballs settle onto the corners of a vast illuminated property board game, soft particles rising, anticipation, slow dolly across the board.
A glowing holographic soccer ball icon and a tiny golden house icon hover and merge in mid-air above a board game, a beam of light connecting them, magical, no text, slow rotation.
A glowing footprint trail of light races forward across the squares of a giant illuminated property board, a golden football token sliding several squares ahead, dynamic motion blur, magical energy.
Glowing vertical golden jail bars slam down out of darkness over one empty corner of a board game, a cold blue spotlight inside the cell, ominous, slow heavy camera move.

The soccer player sits calmly on a glowing throne at the corner of a giant property board game wearing a sky-blue and white round-neck football shirt, confident half-smile, soft golden rim light, subtle breathing, slow push-in.

The soccer player in a sky-blue and white shirt raises three fingers as three glowing golden footballs drop one by one into his open hand, light flooding his corner of the board, triumphant but calm, cinematic slow motion.

The soccer player calmly places three small glowing houses onto a sky-blue avenue of a giant property board game, the whole row lighting up under his hand, quiet domination, top-down then tilt up to his face.

The soccer player in a blue France round-neck shirt blurs with electric speed around the edge of a glowing property board, grinning, trails of blue light following his golden token, fast energetic camera whip.

A glowing golden chance card floats down into the hands of the soccer player in a blue France shirt; it flares with light as he looks at it and breaks into a confident grin, golden particles swirling, cinematic hero moment, slow push-in.
The soccer player in a blue France shirt places two glowing houses on the board then his golden token surges several squares up the table, chasing a leader's glowing blue empire ahead, dynamic dolly.
The tall blond soccer player in a red Norway round-neck shirt slams two glowing houses down onto a property board like laying concrete, jaw set, machine-like and powerful, low heroic angle.
The tall blond soccer player in a red Norway shirt stacks glowing houses into a tall fortified wall on the board, brick by brick, cold determined expression, the wall climbing upward, slow tilt up.
Slow ominous camera glide across a glowing property board game toward one dark corner where cold golden jail bars glow, the rest of the board bright and busy, the cell shadowed and lonely, cinematic.

The soccer player in a dark red Portugal round-neck shirt stands behind glowing golden jail bars, both hands gripping the bars, proud and defiant, staring out at a bright board he cannot reach, cold blue light on his face, heartbeat-slow push-in, single tear of frustration, no humiliation only resolve.

Inside a glowing cell, the soccer player in a dark red shirt rolls two glowing dice across the floor in slow motion; they tumble and settle on a losing roll; his shoulders tense, jaw clenches, then his eyes lift with fierce determination, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting.
A blurred crowd of Pixar-style football fans in stadium silhouettes outside the glowing board hall, anxious and whispering, soft bokeh lights, shallow focus, gentle sway.

Tight cinematic close-up of the soccer player in a dark red shirt behind glowing bars, slow exhale, a small confident nod to himself, the bars beginning to flicker as if they might break, embers, hopeful turn.

Sweeping wide aerial shot over the entire glowing property board game: one corner a vast bright blue empire of houses, two other corners glowing and climbing, and one far corner dark behind golden bars, a golden hooded figure floating over the center, epic scale, slow orbit.
The golden hooded faceless figure sweeps a hand over a glowing leaderboard made of floating stacks of golden coins and tiny houses of different heights, no text, magical particles, slow push-in.
Close detail of a glowing sky-blue avenue on the board crowded with little houses, the tallest empire on the board, warm proud light, slow dolly along the row of houses.
The golden hooded figure sweeps a fan of glowing cards back into a deck and the whole board resets to a neutral cool glow, a clean slate, smooth magical transition, particles.

Two giant glowing dice rise slowly into the air above a vast property board and hang there spinning, charged with light and tension, the four corner thrones glowing in the background, epic anticipation, slow upward camera.

The soccer player in a dark red Portugal shirt behind flickering golden bars slowly lifts his eyes to the rising dice, a dangerous determined half-smile, the bars cracking with light, comeback energy, slow push-in.

A glowing golden World Cup style trophy (generic, no logos) hovers above the far end of the giant board game, light cascading down the board toward four corner thrones, awe and grandeur, slow rise reveal.

Slow majestic pull-back revealing the entire cathedral hall, the colossal glowing property board, the golden hooded figure at center turning slowly toward camera, a soft glowing call-to-action portal of light in the foreground (no text), warm inviting cinematic finish.

The single golden coin from the opening spins once more and falls, the camera snaps to black at the moment it lands, the golden hooded figure's hood the last thing glowing before darkness, clean ending.
